hypothesis: Correct S008's structure-to-number family mapping by adding one nonconstant 45/0 structure vector exactly once.
features: One 45-dimensional family vector: 45 for each of the six numbers in the S005 structure ticket, 0 for the other 39; append this vector once to the six S001/S002/S003/S004/S006/S007 rank vectors and average seven families.
calculation_method: Seven-family equal average: six unchanged component rank vectors plus one corrected S005 structure membership vector.
train_cutoff_rule: Each target t receives rounds 1..t-1 only.
holdout_rounds: recent200/recent100/recent50 are descriptive post-hoc windows, not untouched holdout.
multiple_testing_notes: One frozen mapping, one model, no parameter search or variants; legacy S008 and S005 are reference-only diagnostics.
selection_bias_notes: Historical diagnostic; not prospective and not independent of existing component families.
next_research_direction: Keep H005_FIX separate; require untouched prospective confirmation before any promotion.
